name: CounterBench
description: CounterBench is a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate large language models' ability to perform counterfactual reasoning using formal rules. It contains 1,000 questions with varying difficulty, diverse causal graph structures, and multiple types of counterfactual questions.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly used in the originating paper.
notes: Focuses on formal counterfactual inference rather than commonsense causal reasoning; includes a novel reasoning paradigm CoIn to improve LLM performance.
